pages.text: Use an Empty Grail on a full normal Great Chalice and obtain the Filled Grail.

pages.title: To the Brim
pages.text: Six Great Essences supply two complete refills for powering the Soul Furnace, while blood supports first companion experiments.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Great Chalice uses seven Copper Ingots and Empty Grail uses three. The Chalice holds 12 charges: three Great Essences fill it. Use the Empty Grail on a full normal Chalice. For this experiment keep it separate from a Soul Furnace: the furnace below automatically takes a full charge. Afterwards place

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: it above the furnace and refill.
